question: Identify the synonym of 'Elusive':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Slippery)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Elusive"** means something or someone that is difficult to find, catch, or achieve; it is tricky or hard to grasp either physically or metaphorically. (दुर्बोध/पकड़ में न आने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The solution to the puzzle was elusive, even to the most skilled players.
 
 
 
• **"Slippery"** refers to something smooth and difficult to hold, or metaphorically, something that is hard to catch or pin down. (फिसलन भरा)
 
 
• **Example:** The thief was as slippery as an eel, escaping every time the police closed in.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Elusive'** is **'Slippery'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Slippery)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Clear** (स्पष्ट): Easy to understand or see, not ambiguous.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were clear and easy to follow.
 
 
 
• **Easy** (आसान): Not difficult, requiring little effort.
 
 
• **Example:** The test was easy, and most students finished it quickly.
 
 
 
• **Obvious** (स्पष्ट): Easily perceived or understood; clear and apparent.
 
 
• **Example:** It was obvious that she was upset after the argument.
